Would love this to be available, Sometimes i have vrc just open when working on an avatar and having to deal with constant invites is a pain
Results based on current status
When orange:  "you never accept my invites!"
When red: "you're never available!"
Having a hidden status would make it possible to just keep running vrc without anyone being any wiser. Other options would be the use of smurf accounts with 0 friends but that's not ideal either.

@{5ae243864dc68c67fe796424|full_name}: This would also be ideal for times when one wants to record video without everyone jumping all over them. "Online Availability" can be stressful. If I walk into an IRL club, and 15 people are there, I'm only "on" for 15 people. If I log into *insert social media platform* I'm "on" for an entire friend list, which could be hundred/thousands of people. No one should feel anxious before logging on to VRChat.
Also, perhaps there could be a sort of "white list" of friends who you never have to be invisible with, while the majority of your friends would see you as invisible. Like, there could be a checkbox for "Does Invisible status apply for white list friends?" If you have a production team, or work as a DJ with a few promoters/DJs/Hosts/VIPs, I feel like it could be helpful to do that without the world seeing it. It sure helps me out on Discord!
